text:
maya: Heads-up we're greenlighting a paid push for the "LLM in Prod" launch webinar w/ joint talk next Wed. Draft plan in thread: search + retarget + short-form social. can ops check budgets, tracking, and a contingency if CPA drifts?
josh: For search I recommend two ad groups: high-intent keywords (exact & phrase) and discovery (bmm). Start with $800/day total, front-load 55% first 36h.
carla: creative ask: need 3 headlines + 2 descriptions + 1 short 4s loop GIF for retarget. can we use motion of the latency chart? also want one copy variant that mentions "live Q&A".
ben: Lead routing: SFDC mapping use queue=webinar_reg, owner rotate to @sd_leads, set source=paid_search. include hidden field lead_channel=paid and utm_source=google. ensure conversion event is "webinar_reg_submit".
ads-bot: Draft campaign created: id=camp_91234 status=draft owner=@maya -- conversion_action not set.
maya: Benchmarks to monitor first 48h: CTR >2.2%, CPC <$3.25, CVR >=1.2% (reg). target CPA $45-60. if CPA >$80 after 24h throttle creative + adjust bids.
josh: Targeting: exact: "llm inference", "model serving"; broad-mod: +llm +inference +deployment. retarget: last 21 days, cap 4 impressions/day, exclude registrants 14 days. bid uplift retarget +20%.
carla: Naming conv: REDW_LAUNCH_2026_APR_search_vA / _rt_vA. Ops please include variant suffixes for creatives.
maya: Bulk edit CSV for ops (paste into UI):
```
Campaign,DailyBudget,BiddingStrategy,Status
"REDW_LAUNCH_2026_APR_search_vA",880,MaximizeConversions,Enabled
"REDW_LAUNCH_2026_APR_rt_vA",420,TargetCPA(50),Paused
```
ben: Confirmed I'll add SFDC automation: tag paid_webinar, set Lead Source = Google Ads, and kick nurture (email 0h, 24h, 72h). also will add remarketing audience of page viewers 7-21d.
maya: Ops checklist: 1) set conversion action 2) upload assets 3) QA pixel on /thank-you 4) confirm UTM + hidden fields 5) unpause.
josh: Quick ops note: if CPC spikes >$4, reduce broad-match spend and push discovery to schedule hours with better CPA (9am-6pm PT).
carla: Timeline: assets by EOD tomorrow? @maya can approve creative by noon.
maya: yes EOD tomorrow target. i'll loop legal if the "3x" claim appears.
ads-bot: Reminder: conversion_action missing for camp_91234 -- set before enabling.
